# EazeeBooks

> AI-powered invoice and accounting software. EazeeBooks extracts, structures, and exports invoice, bill, and bank-statement data automatically — built for freelancers, small businesses, and companies, with UAE VAT support (AED pricing, 5% VAT itemized at checkout). Exports straight into QuickBooks and Zoho Books.

EazeeBooks lets a business upload an invoice (PDF or photo) and get back clean, structured, exportable data — no manual entry. It supports customer and supplier tracking, bank statement processing, multi-company management for freelancers, and role-based access for teams. A 7-day free trial is available, no credit card required.
